forms.label: Freshly squeezed
forms.sourceNote: Nutrition and sugar are the FNDDS record for grapefruit juice, 100%, freshly squeezed (2709176), which reports sugars where the SR Legacy pink-raw record does not. Density is that SR Legacy record's own cup portion (167774), 1.044 g/ml, adopted because juice is poured rather than packed. Both public domain. No acid figure is carried: grapefruit's titratable acidity is not covered by the site's lemon/lime convention and no other source was checked, so acidPercent is left off rather than estimated.
